cues: Couplet three gives the reason, beginning with for, the only logical connective in the poem.
We are richly linked in hope: richly, just after poverty, relocates wealth into connection.
Woven in history, like a mountain rope.
Think about a climbing rope, as a Nepali reader can.
It is many strands twisted into one.
It is useless unless tied at both ends.
And it exists for one purpose: going up.
text: Couplet three gives the reason, beginning with for, the only logical connective in the poem. We are richly linked in hope: richly, just after poverty, relocates wealth into connection. Woven in history, like a mountain rope. Think about a climbing rope, as a Nepali reader can. It is many strands twisted into one. It is useless unless tied at both ends. The climbers share one fate. And it exists for one purpose: going up.
